modules.goal: Implement A1 and sheet reference parsing, formula lexing, AST construction, input limit enforcement, and FormulaError exceptions.
acceptance: IF formula string exceeds maxFormulaLength of 4096 characters THEN parseFormula raises FormulaError with code 'FORMULA_TOO_LONG'
IF formula nesting exceeds maxExpressionDepth of 64 levels THEN parseFormula raises FormulaError with code 'EXPRESSION_TOO_DEEP'
WHEN parsing formula '=SUM(Sheet1!$A$1:$B$2, 42)' THEN parseFormula returns AST with function name 'SUM' and reference 'Sheet1!$A$1:$B$2'
WHEN parsing cell coordinate '$C$10' THEN parseCellReference returns row 10 and col 3 with absolute row and column flags true

modules.goal: Implement the core spreadsheet built-in function library across Math, Logic, Text, Lookup, Date and Finance families, including serial dates and Excel 1900 leap bug.
acceptance: WHEN the committed table test/fixtures/functions.json (at least 3 cases per implemented function) runs THEN every case matches, with floats compared at relative tolerance 1e-9
WHEN evaluating function 'PMT' with rate 0.05 / 12, nper 60, pv -10000 THEN evaluateFunction returns 188.7121655
WHEN evaluating function 'SUM' with array argument [[1, 2], [3, 4]] THEN evaluateFunction returns 10
WHEN evaluating function 'CONCAT' with arguments ['Hello', ' ', 'World'] THEN evaluateFunction returns 'Hello World'

modules.goal: Implement the dependency DAG for cell references, incremental dirty node propagation, topological order calculation, and Tarjan or DFS cycle detection.
acceptance: WHEN a circular dependency edge 'A1' -> 'B1' and 'B1' -> 'A1' is added THEN graph.detectCycle('A1') returns ['A1', 'B1']
WHEN 'B1' changes in graph where 'A1' depends on 'B1' and 'C1' is independent THEN graph.getEvaluationOrder(['B1']) returns order ['A1']
WHEN diamond dependency graph A1->B1, A1->C1, B1->D1, C1->D1 is invalidated from 'D1' THEN graph.getEvaluationOrder(['D1']) returns ['B1', 'C1', 'A1'] with each node evaluated exactly once

modules.goal: Implement the public Workbook class orchestrating cell storage, incremental recalculation, cycle isolation, formula evaluation, custom function registration, and JSON serialization.
acceptance: WHEN a cell is set with '=SUM(B1:B3)' and cells 'B1', 'B2', 'B3' contain 10, 20, 30 THEN wb.getValue('A1') returns 60
WHEN a circular dependency is created with 'A1' set to '=B1+1' and 'B1' set to '=A1+1' THEN wb.getValue('A1') returns '#CIRC!' and wb.getCycle('A1') returns ['A1', 'B1']
WHEN 'B1' changes from 10 to 40 in a workbook where 'A1' is '=B1*2' and 'C1' is '=5+5' THEN wb.setCell('B1', 40) returns { evaluated: ['A1'] } and wb.getValue('A1') returns 80
WHEN evaluating formula '=IFERROR(1/0, 99)' THEN wb.getValue('A1') returns 99
WHEN evaluating '=DATE(1900, 2, 29)' with excel1900LeapBug enabled THEN wb.getValue('A1') returns serial number 60
WHEN evaluating formula '=INDEX(A1:B2, 2, 1)' where range 'A1:B2' contains [[1, 2], [3, 4]] THEN wb.getValue('C1') returns 3
WHEN 200 seeded property sequences of random edits run THEN every cell value after incremental recalculation equals a full recalculation of a fresh workbook loaded from wb.toJSON()
WHEN registering custom function 'DOUBLE' as (x: number) => x * 2 THEN evaluating '=DOUBLE(21)' returns 42

modules.goal: Implement the command line runner for headless formula evaluation and the CI conformance test setup and harness comparing against LibreOffice headless.
acceptance: WHEN the CI conformance job evaluates 20000 random typed formulas in this engine and in LibreOffice headless THEN at least 99 percent of values match at relative tolerance 1e-9

WHEN running CLI with arguments ['--eval', '=SUM(1, 2, 3)'] THEN run exits with code 0 and writes '6
' to stdout
WHEN running CLI with invalid syntax arguments ['--eval', '=(1+'] THEN run exits with code 1 and writes 'SYNTAX_ERROR' to stderr
